notes.title: Update Note 2020.05.29
notes.content:
(20.05.29)Update
[b]Added[/b]
- Change channel : You can change the channel in the main lobby.
- How to change the channel
1. Open the menu
2. Select Settings.
3. Select the Change button next to the channel.
4. Select a channel to change or create a new channel.

[b]Fixed[/b]
Friend list: UI bug fixed.
Friend list: 'Invite friends' and 'Follow friends' bug fixed

notes.title: Update Note 2020.05.22
notes.content:
(20.05.22)Update
[b]Added[/b]
- Block System : Now, you can block the bad player's voice.
- How to block the bad player's voice
 1. Open the menu.
 2. Select Community from the menu.
 3. Select the bad player's block button from the 'Current player' list.
 4. In the 'Block List', you can check the users you blocked and unblock them.

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Friend list : 'Follow a friend' Button bug fixed
- Costume : Fixed the Overlaid Costume Problem
- Costume : Lighting related bug fixed
